criteria.reasoning: Clear goals, function, users and Australian need identified with literature links. Objectives for SST, thermal stress, bathymetry and colour detection stated. Requirements lack quantified performance.
Gantt with weekly tasks, deadlines and staged STK work shows feasibility. No contingency provision, weak linkage of why sequence suits mission, and no explicit future information-source list.
No results, plots, calculations or interpretation presented. Tutorials claimed without evidence. Major orbit error indicates not on track technically.
Logical structure, readable writing, consistent formatting, labelled Gantt. Footnote URLs match superscripts but lack formal reference style and in-text citation consistency.

technical_issues.issue: States geostationary orbit at 600 km altitude: physically impossible, GEO is ~35786 km; 600 km is LEO and cannot be fixed above reef.

overall: Promising reef-monitoring concept with good rationale and usable plan, but no technical results and critical orbit misconception undermine readiness for full design.
